focus.rationale: T13 re-derivation (2026-09-10, permissive reading, §10.2.1): smoothing_route is silicone_film on a two-observation SFR-high read (film: Dimethicone r3, Phenyl Trimethicone r9; lubrication: Coco-Caprylate r5, Neopentyl Glycol Diheptanoate r6), clearing §7.4.1's two-observation test — consistent with the product's own 'Bond Smoother' identity (§10.2.1's stated rationale for adopting the permissive reading names this record explicitly). COND high was over-satisfied (the LGN pair r2/r7 alone would have carried it, with the silicone system and the dry-feel esters both available as further independent routes), so under the conservative reading the silicone film read as baseline conditioning; under the now-adopted permissive reading, the LGN pair alone leaves it beyond baseline. `repair` remains unavailable: R2 is `none_visible` (the qualifying silane sits below the tail marker), no C1/C2 marketing position exists at all for this product, and the R3 `chemistry_candidate` bond flag alone may never set `repair` as primary (R14) — as a secondary focus it would additionally need an independent moderate+ observation, and the only candidate (the below-marker silane) does not clear the rank prong, so it is not taken; this reasoning is unaffected by T13, which only removed the now-moot marketing-position route. Every other route fails its own gate (curl_definition: HOLD none; heat_styling: `application_stage` lacks `pre_heat` — T14 (2026-09-10) moved HEAT to `claim_only`/`true`, but the `heat_styling` route independently requires `application_stage` to include `pre_heat` (§10.2), and this record's frozen directions support only `towel_dry`, so the route still fails; detangling: no C1/C2 positioning; volume_lightness: WT high; shine: would restate the film). This record's pre-T13 `focus` uncertain_fields entry — recorded because the §10.2.1 reading, not the evidence, decided it — is removed: the reading is now a settled rule.
focus.derivation: §10.2: qualifying routes are collected beyond baseline conditioning (§10.2.1, permissive reading T13b), then the rank order repair > smoothing > curl_definition > heat_styling > detangling > volume_lightness > shine binds.
thresholdReasoning: Selected primary `smoothing` with secondary [].
§10.2 principle 4: official positioning may corroborate a route but never creates one.
limitations: A focus is a statement of distinctive purpose, not an efficacy claim or a measured endpoint.
